nodes.description: Public address of the LRC ERC20 token contract used for balance checks and transfers.
Address that is allowed to start the program and receive unlocked LRC tokens.
LRC balance locked in the contract measured at start time.
Cumulative amount of LRC already withdrawn by the owner.
Monthly unlockable amount = lrcInitialBalance / 24.
Timestamp when the freeze program was started; 0 means not started.
Monotonic counter of successful withdrawals, emitted in Withdrawal events.
Constant freeze duration of 720 days (2 years).
Constructor: validates and stores the LRC token address and owner address.
Owner-only function that records the initial locked balance, monthly unlock amount and start timestamp.
Payable fallback: owner-only withdrawal entry point that transfers unlocked LRC tokens to the owner.
Internal view of the unlocked amount based on elapsed months minus already withdrawn amount, capped by balance.
SafeMath library multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath library division with implicit divide-by-zero revert.
Caller address, used for owner authorization in start and in the fallback function.
Block timestamp (now), used to gate unlock timing and to compute the unlocked amount.
External call Token(lrcTokenAddress).balanceOf(address(this)) executed in start().
External call token.transfer(owner, lrcAmount) sending LRC out of the contract; potential reentrancy vector.
External call token.balanceOf(address(this)) executed in the fallback function.
Arithmetic state update lrcWithdrawn += lrcAmount in the fallback function.
Arithmetic computation unlockable = (_now - startTime - FREEZE_PERIOD).div(30 days).mul(lrcUnlockPerMonth) - lrcWithdrawn.
Arithmetic computation lrcUnlockPerMonth = lrcInitialBalance.div(24) in start().
Constructor parameter for the LRC ERC20 token address.
Constructor parameter for the owner address.
Parameter _now of calculateLRCUnlockAmount, the timestamp used for the unlock calculation.
Parameter _balance of calculateLRCUnlockAmount, upper bound of the returned amount.
First operand a of SafeMath.mul.
Second operand b of SafeMath.mul.
Numerator a of SafeMath.div.
Denominator b of SafeMath.div.
Local variable token = Token(lrcTokenAddress) in the fallback function.
Local variable balance holding the contract's current LRC balance in the fallback function.
Local variable lrcAmount returned by calculateLRCUnlockAmount and transferred to the owner.
Local variable unlockable holding the computed unlocked-but-not-withdrawn LRC amount.
Local variable c = a * b inside SafeMath.mul.
Local variable c = a / b inside SafeMath.div.

edges.reason: The constructor takes _lrcTokenAddress as an input parameter.
Constructor parameter _lrcTokenAddress is stored into lrcTokenAddress.
The constructor takes _owner as an input parameter.
Constructor parameter _owner is stored into the owner state variable.
start() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner), making the caller the access-control subject.
owner is read to compare against msg.sender in start().
start() assigns the untrusted block timestamp to startTime, creating a timestamp dependency.
start() writes the startTime state variable.
startTime is set from the untrusted block timestamp (now).
start() performs the external balanceOf call on the token contract.
lrcTokenAddress determines the target contract of the external balanceOf call.
The external balanceOf result is assigned to lrcInitialBalance.
lrcInitialBalance is the dividend of lrcInitialBalance.div(24).
The result of the div operation is stored into lrcUnlockPerMonth.
lrcInitialBalance.div(24) invokes SafeMath.div on the state variable.
SafeMath.div consumes its numerator parameter a.
SafeMath.div consumes its denominator parameter b.
SafeMath.div computes the local variable c = a / b.
SafeMath.mul consumes its first operand a.
SafeMath.mul consumes its second operand b.
SafeMath.mul computes the local variable c = a * b.
The unlockable calculation calls SafeMath.mul(lrcUnlockPerMonth).
The unlockable calculation calls SafeMath.div(30 days).
The fallback function is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
owner is read to authorize the withdrawal inside the fallback function.
The fallback function requires now > startTime + FREEZE_PERIOD, a block timestamp dependency.
startTime is compared against the block timestamp to allow withdrawals.
FREEZE_PERIOD is used in the withdrawal time gate.
The fallback function calls token.balanceOf on the external token contract.
lrcTokenAddress determines the target contract of the balanceOf call.
The balanceOf result is stored into the local balance variable.
The local token variable is used to perform the balanceOf call.
The fallback function calls calculateLRCUnlockAmount(now, balance).
The current balance is passed as _balance to the unlock calculation.
The untrusted block timestamp is passed as _now into the unlock calculation.
Parameter _now (block timestamp) feeds the unlockable arithmetic computation.
Parameter _now is used to derive the local unlockable value.
Parameter _balance caps the amount returned by calculateLRCUnlockAmount.
lrcWithdrawn is subtracted inside the unlockable computation.
startTime is subtracted inside the unlockable computation.
lrcUnlockPerMonth is multiplied inside the unlockable computation.
FREEZE_PERIOD is subtracted inside the unlockable computation.
The unlockable arithmetic expression produces the local unlockable variable.
unlockable is the value returned by calculateLRCUnlockAmount.
The returned unlock amount is assigned to the local lrcAmount in the fallback function.
lrcAmount is the value transferred out to the owner.
lrcAmount is added to lrcWithdrawn in the state update.
The fallback function performs the external token.transfer call, which can re-enter the contract.
The external token instance is used to execute the transfer call.
owner is the recipient of the transferred LRC tokens.
The fallback function increments withdrawId in the Withdrawal event.
The fallback function executes the lrcWithdrawn += lrcAmount state update.
lrcWithdrawn is read and updated in the arithmetic state update.
